answer: Each new key deposits slashable stake into a public vault and begins a signed log of paid tasks. Influence stays at zero until that log reaches a summit: a season of counterparties whose payments and clocks are uncorrelated. If two keys share a funder, a machine, or lock-step timing, they are fused and the vault is slashed as one. Only a trail with an ivory grain—an irregular pattern of partners and pauses no batch of labels can stamp together—can vest, so a farm just multiplies the same cut.
